exports.buildKiroRegistration: Optional replacement for the inline registration payload in kiro.requestDeviceCode in src/lib/oauth/providers.js. Preserve validated region/startUrl, selected proxy, existing mapTokens, flowStore state/ownership/PKCE guards and connection persistence. Pass the resolved builder-id or idc method. Current production already omits issuerUrl for IDC; this helper consolidates that contract without new OAuth wiring.
